notes: REF-BM-02: only title+description(+site) scraped from OG/meta; no favicon or preview image collected. REF-BM-03: title/description editable only after save; create is immediate with no pre-save edit form. REF-BM-04: update() edits title/description/tags/note but not url. REF-BM-07: list exposes title/description/tags but favicon is a CSS letter-avatar placeholder, not a real favicon. REF-BM-11: no clickable tag / tag-filter mechanism; tags only matched via generic substring search. REF-BM-14: no #tag syntax (stored tags have no '#', so '#x' never matches). REF-BM-15: matchesQuery is implicit-AND all-words only; no OR/NOT/parentheses. REF-BM-16: query is whitespace-split; quoted phrases not treated as exact matches. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions in UI or API. REF-BM-22: fixed newest-first order in store.list(); no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot or Internet Archive functionality. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import/export. REF-BM-32: no user settings (sort/items/font size).
